exam_scheme.note: DSSSB conducts the Combined Examination for Grade-II (GNCTDSS) / Assistant Section Officer (Services Department, DPCC, DUSIB) under Two-Tier General (II T-G) examination scheme. Tier-I is qualifying in nature for shortlisting candidates, while final merit is strictly prepared on cumulative marks obtained in Tier-II (Part-I MCQ + Part-II Descriptive out of 300 marks).

financial_package.note: Appointees to Grade-II (GNCTDSS) / Assistant Section Officer / Head Clerk in Services Department and Delhi GNCTD bodies are governed under the Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 (7th CPC) in Pay Level 7 with an initial basic pay of ₹44,900. Delhi is classified as a Class 'X' higher TPTA metro city for allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: DSSSB Advt No. 01/2026 — Post Code 804/26 Specification (Pay Scale ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400, Level 7)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 7 Entry Basic ₹44,900 with 58% DA (₹26,042), Delhi metro Class 'X' HRA @ 30% (₹13,470), and Transport Allowance @ ₹3,600 + 58% DA (₹5,688), giving ₹90,100 gross pay before standard 10% NPS deduction (₹7,094), DGEHS health contribution (₹650), and tax withholding.
official_perks: Delhi Government Employees Health Scheme (DGEHS) / CGHS cashless medical coverage across empanelled private and government super-specialty hospitals in Delhi NCR
GNCTD General Pool Residential Accommodation (GPRA) allotment eligibility across government residential colonies in Delhi
Central government Leave Travel Concession (LTC) with all-India travel block coverage
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child (up to two children) plus annual hostel subsidy
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined employer contribution by Government of NCT of Delhi
Annual increment of 3% on Basic Pay on 1st January or 1st July each year

competition_benchmarks.note: Recruitment for executive assistant cadres in Delhi Administration has been unified under Combined Examination 2026 (Advt No. 01/2026) for Grade-II (GNCTDSS) / Assistant Section Officer across Services Department, DPCC, and DUSIB. Vacancies were revised upward from 576 to 606 in Services Department alone vide Corrigendum dated 26-05-2026, totaling 617 vacancies across all three participating departments.

years.source_label: DSSSB Corrigendum dt 26-05-2026 & Advt No. 01/2026: Post Code 804/26 Services Department revised to 606 (UR 223, OBC 155, SC 101, ST 44, EWS 83, PwBD 25) plus DPCC (3) and DUSIB (8), totaling 617 vacancies.
